internet.question: Do I need an Internet connection to use Wafriq?
internet.answer: Not necessarily. The app works even offline for basic functions (billing, checkout). Your data will be synced as soon as you reconnect.

devices.question: Which phones or tablets are compatible?
devices.answer: Wafriq works on all Android devices (version 6.0 and above) and iOS (version 12 and above). We recommend a screen of at least 5 inches for a better experience.

hardware.question: How can I purchase hardware (printer, cash drawer, etc.)?
hardware.answer: You can order directly from our online store or contact us for personalized delivery. We also offer complete packages at reduced prices.

restaurants.question: Is Wafriq suitable for restaurants?
restaurants.answer: Absolutely! Wafriq has specific features for catering: table management, kitchen orders, tips, and more.

affiliate.question: How does the affiliate program work?
